summary: Configuration entry-point that persists a callback function pointer (a1) and an associated integer argument (a2) into two adjacent globals, dword_8B8F00 and dword_8B8EFC, and returns the original callback pointer. Called from VidMan_Init (0x004FA320), so it registers a video-management callback pair.

operations.description: Seed result with a1 so the function returns the stored callback pointer unchanged.
Store the callback pointer a1 into global dword_8B8F00.
Store the associated integer argument a2 into global dword_8B8EFC.
Return the original callback pointer a1.

unresolved: Semantic purpose of globals dword_8B8F00 / dword_8B8EFC and the callback they pair is caller- (VidMan_Init) defined; unknown here.
Meaning of the integer argument a2 stored alongside the callback pointer.
